messages:
maya: Hey folks — pushed a small followup to fix the race in kv-allocator and squash the two debug commits. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4623 PTAL when you have a minute. Tests are green locally but CI has been flaky for the batching suite.
sam: Thanks — will take a look after standup. Did you rebase on main? I saw a conflict with the batching tests earlier.
maya: Yep rebased onto main at 1749988000, resolved the conflict in batching/test_integration.py and added a tiny unit for the rotation edge case.
leah: :eyes: quick question — is this a behavioral change? We try to avoid any semantics differences for Dedicated.
maya: No behavioral change — only reorders cleanup calls to avoid the race. Added an inline comment and a changelog line. Diff snippet: ```diff
-    # old cleanup order
-    cleanup_a()
-    cleanup_b()
+    # new cleanup order — avoids kv rotation race
+    cleanup_b()
+    cleanup_a()
```
toni: CI just picked it up. If it's small and CI passes I'll merge after you squash into one commit. Can you drop the debug-log commit you left in?
maya: Dropped the debug log commit and force-pushed to branch fix/kv-squash. Squashed into a single commit message: `kv: fix allocator rotation + robust cleanup`.
ci-bot: CI started for fix/kv-squash — build #8421 — unit tests running.
sam: Quick skim looks fine. One nit about a variable name (suggest `tok_count` -> `token_count`) but not a blocker.
maya: Addressed the nit and force-pushed. PTAL @sam @leah — trying to merge before tomorrow's canary cutover. If anyone objects speak now.
leah: :thumbsup: no objections from me. Please add a short note in the canary changelog referencing the fix.
maya: Added changelog entry in docs/release/canary.md and pushed. CI passed: https://ci.redwood/8421/pipeline — merging after final LGTM.
sam: LGTM. :shipit:
ci-bot: Merge queued. Deployed to canary in ~10m, will notify #eng-releases when the rollout completes.
